description: This file is a configuration include for MIPS tune settings within a Yocto Project environment. It defines architecture-specific tuning options, compiler flags, available tunes, and architecture-related variables for different MIPS variants such as mips32, mips32el, and their NF (no floating point) variants.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: Utility method used to check if a certain feature is included in the TUNE_FEATURES variable to conditionally append compiler flags.
